note: This metric is not age-standardized, so differences between countries partly reflect differences in their age structure.
title: Share of people aged 70 and older with bipolar disorder
subtitle: Estimated share of people aged 70 and older who have [bipolar disorder](#dod:bipolar_disorder), whether or not they are diagnosed, based on representative surveys, medical data, and statistical modeling. Prevalence is measured as the share experiencing bipolar disorder at a given point in time. It does not measure lifetime prevalence.
